data_role: Traditional pure-pursuit plus curvature speed-cap tuning DEV on the same four selected task routes and banks1/3. Rule uses no learned middle output and no alpha preference input; alpha0.5 is a fixed bookkeeping/reward context. Tune on these DEV cases, then freeze selected rule(s) for new-combination evaluation.
scoring: Original goal+H10+8-10s original cross RMSE<=0.25m; buffered-anchor narrow halfwidth0.9m, wide halfwidth1.4m and actual turn mean speed>=0.85 request. Same scoring for U170/H75/W400/u325; U170 parent outcomes already inspected, so this is model-selection DEV.
stop_rule: Exactly8 nominal H10 episodes, max16000 lower ticks, zero optimizer; no automatic extension.
question: Can a conventional pure-pursuit follower with a tunable 6m preview curvature speed cap meet both original-path and turn-speed tasks under the common lower/physics/replanning stack?
speed_scope_note: Low-speed flags retain their literal <=2.2 m/s meaning; high-speed rows are not low-speed evidence. Initial bank is shared and acceleration is included; actual in-turn speed must be reported before calling a case high-speed.
initial_state_scope: Prepared complete banks1/3 from authenticated eight-state friction0.8 bank. These banks may have prior project use; no claim of independent random-state TEST.
